aiVerification.summary: Comparable validation report, but changed-factor labeling and some outcome extraction need correction before Ask AI use.
issues: Primary changed factor is new vendor CSY Tech Vina suspension-D first lot, not generic Test/Lot test labels.
Changed condition incorrectly merges Test and Lot test row types across different dates/tests.
Vision spot outcome uses zero defect column instead of total NG/rate, understating improvement.
Decision and narrative result rows are not cited, including final use approval.
Tension outcome left unjudged despite PASS rows and OK narrative.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to CSY Tech Vina new vendor SUS-ARRAY suspension-D first lot 3 vs normal condition.
Keep Test and Lot test as subgroup/test-stage labels, not separate primary changed conditions.
Recalculate vision spot using total NG and NG rate values from both rows.
Add result narrative and final decision rows to evidence citations.
Judge tension as pass/no issue with limitation that numeric spec is blank.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are incomplete; add headers, narrative results, and final decision rows.
